Author: unknown
Name: Auto Craft Cycle
Description: Repeats material restocking and crafting in inn rooms, collectable deliveries, scrip exchanges, and optional Grand Company deliveries. Supports IPC integration with other plugins.
Punchline: Automates material restocking, crafting, collectable delivery, and scrip exchange.
Changelog: Adds conditional automatic retainer inventory scans and per-material rejected-price history. Fixes manual-stop home return, confirmed purchase totals and replenishment status layout stability.

Author: unknown
Name: Submarine Sell Item Tracker
Description: Tracks eight submarine salvage items, NPC sale values, and character-held gil across characters. Includes automatic scans, service account and world summaries, CSV export, and AutoRetainer completion reports through Discord webhooks. Use /subinv to open or /subinv settings to configure notifications.
Punchline: Track submarine salvage items and sale values across characters.
Changelog: Adds per-run submarine item gain counts and gil totals to Discord reports.

Author: karaage
Name: Submarine Logistics Manager
Description: Use /slm to open. Select supply or NPC selling for each character and process them in data center and world priority order. Supports protection for ten designated items, gil and inventory space tracking, low-stock warnings, and persistent failure history. Free Destination Check visits characters with unknown or non-Limsa security token free destinations, registers Limsa when needed, and returns to the FC house before logout. Requires Lifestream and vnavmesh.
Punchline: Manage submarine supplies, NPC selling, free destinations, and automated multi-character runs.
Changelog: Fixes NPC selling stopping on the buyback tab. Adds Free Destination Check next to Start with Current Character: loads unknown security token free destinations, registers Limsa when needed, then returns to the FC house and logs out before switching characters. Uses data center and world priorities, three total attempts per step, cancellation, and persistent failure history. Preserves supply and NPC selling selections and completion flags.
